name: orchestrate
description: Coordinates parallel subagents through Beads-backed DAGs, claims, threaded replies, decisions, review, and merge state. Supports exact, specialist, generic-pull, writable-fallback, and read-only research dispatch. Bundles workflow-coder, workflow-pull-worker, workflow-worker, workflow-researcher, workflow-reviewer, workflow-advisor, integration-gatekeeper, and ledger-scribe. Includes deterministic scope, discovery, claim, message, decision, queue, and conflict scripts plus shared PR shepherd landing safeguards. Requires the bd CLI.
